title: tc-page-slide
description: Moves between views by sliding them side by side as `view` changes, the height gliding along.

view.description: The key of the view on show – change it to slide to another view

direction.description: Which way to slide: "forward" brings the new view in from the end, "back" from the start; "auto" works it out from `order`

order.description: The views' keys in order, for "auto" (an attribute takes a comma-separated list); default: the data-view children's order

focusHeading.description: Move focus to the new view's heading after each change

duration.description: Length of the slide in ms; default the --tc-duration-slow token
